title: Mobile foundation — Pack 1
notes: Introduce one Northborn design-token system for typography, spacing, surfaces, borders, semantic colours, radii, focus states and motion.
Standardize mobile field readability at 16px body text, 14px secondary text and a 12px minimum compact-metadata size.
Standardize mobile touch targets at 48px with 52px primary actions.
Add shared Northborn Button, Surface, Status, EmptyState, Skeleton and Sheet primitives for future screen migrations.
Map legacy primary/secondary controls, fields, surfaces, status pills, empty states and modal sheets onto the new design foundation.
Migrate the account menu, Northborn dropdown, date/time picker, signature pad, attachments and authentication controls onto shared tokens.
Replace the old QA micro-font sheet with design-system readability guardrails and remove legacy 10px/sub-48px baselines from the global override layer.
Add reduced-motion handling and documented standards so future packs build on one visual language instead of adding more CSS patches.
